text.en:
The Sitio of Balinpusa of Barangay Inerangan, in the municipality of Alaminos, Province of
Pangasinan, is hereby separated from Barangay Inerangan and constituted into a new barangay in said
municipality to be known as Barangay San Antonio.

The Barangay San Antonio shall be bounded as follows:
"Bounded on the N., along line 2-1 by river, on the N.E., along line 1-5 by San Jose; on the S.E., along line
5-4-3 by Barangay Pugo; and along line 3-2 by Barangay Landoc. Beginning at a point marked "1" on the
prepared plan of proposed Barangay San Antonio, being N. 47°, 47?W., 4,296.91 m. from BLLM No. 1, CAD
325-D Alaminos Cadastre; thence S. 88°, 42?W., 646.32 m. to point 2; thence S. 23°, 33?E 1,434.05 m. to
point 3; thence N. 07°, 31?E., 164.07 m. to point 4; thence N. 68°, 38?E., 544.54 m. to point 5; thence N.
25°, 12?W., 1,071.07 m. to point of beginning, containing an area of seventy-two point eight hundred
eighty-three (72.883) hectares. All points referred to are indicated on the prepared plan and marked on the
ground as follows: points 1, 5, & 4 are B.B.M. No. 34, B.B.M. No. 31, & B.B.M. No. 30, respectively. Points
3 & 2 are P.S. cyl. Conc. Mons. Bearings true."
